zh.heroTitle: 解读肽序列，发现研究价值。
zh.heroLead: 连接序列特征与活性研究方向，在清晰可解释的证据中筛选候选，让下一步验证更有依据。
zh.heroNote: 七种研究方向 · 理化特征解析 · 结果一键导出
zh.sequenceFlow: 序列特征 → 候选优先级
zh.exampleIntro: 从12条示例序列出发，探索不同研究方向下的候选排序与特征解释。
zh.filterBody: 结合序列特征和评分依据，组织适合后续验证的候选清单。
zh.detailTitle: 让每一次排序，都有可读的依据。
zh.detailLead: 连接组成、端基与理化特征，理解不同序列的优先级来源。
zh.selectDetail: 选择上方候选查看详情。
zh.methodsTitle: 从序列特征，形成研究线索。
zh.methodOneBody: 覆盖ACE抑制、抗氧化、抗菌、抗炎、DPP-IV抑制、α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制及广谱活性探索，按研究目标查看候选特征。
zh.methodTwoBody: 整合长度、端基、残基组成、疏水比例和电荷等特征，呈现逐条评分依据，帮助研究者建立候选优先级。
zh.methodThreeBody: 提供筛选结果CSV与完整示例JSON，保留描述符、规则依据和来源指纹，衔接后续实验设计与研究记录。
zh.methodData: 本站使用12条人工指定的示例序列，展示本地程序预计算的理化描述符和0–100规则优先级。分数用于候选排序，活性效应由对应实验评价。
zh.methodMetric: 分子质量采用未修饰线性肽的中性单同位素质量；净电荷按pH 7计算。示例包含规则评分与描述符，机器学习预测、实验IC₅₀和对接结果属于独立分析流程。
zh.methodBrand: 校徽来源：桂林医科大学官网“校徽校旗”。本页为研究项目演示。
zh.methodFooter: 将候选、特征与解释一起保存，让研究选择有据可循。
zh.downloadJson: 下载完整示例与来源 JSON ↗
zh.footer: 序列解析 · 候选优选 · 研究决策

en.heroTitle: Read the sequence. Discover research potential.
en.heroLead: Connect peptide features with bioactivity research. Explore interpretable candidate priorities and plan the next validation step with clearer evidence.
en.heroNote: Seven research directions · Molecular descriptors · Export-ready results
en.exampleIntro: Explore candidate rankings and feature explanations across 12 example sequences and seven research directions.
en.filterBody: Combine sequence features and scoring explanations to organize a focused candidate list for validation.
en.detailTitle: A clear rationale behind every ranking.
en.detailLead: Explore composition, terminal residues and molecular properties to understand each candidate’s priority.
en.selectDetail: Select a candidate above to explore its features.
en.methodsTitle: Turn sequence features into research leads.
en.methodOneBody: Browse ACE inhibition, antioxidant, antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, DPP-IV inhibition, α-glucosidase inhibition and general bioactivity priorities.
en.methodTwoBody: Connect length, termini, residue composition, hydrophobicity and charge with per-sequence explanations for research prioritization.
en.methodThreeBody: Export filtered CSV results or the full example JSON, including descriptors, scoring explanations and source fingerprints for research records.
en.methodData: This explorer presents 12 manually selected example sequences with precomputed molecular descriptors and rule-based priorities on a 0–100 scale. Scores support candidate ranking; corresponding experiments establish activity effects.
en.methodMetric: Mass is the neutral monoisotopic mass of an unmodified linear peptide; charge is calculated at pH 7. Examples contain rule scores and descriptors. Machine-learning predictions, experimental IC₅₀ and docking results belong to separate analysis workflows.
en.methodBrand: Emblem source: Guilin Medical University official website, University Emblem and Flag. This page is a research-project demonstration.
en.methodFooter: Keep candidates, features and explanations together for informed research decisions.
en.footer: Sequence insight · Candidate priorities · Research decisions

en.detailFoot: Rule-based priority · Calculated from sequence features

zh.rulesText: ACE方向整合长度、C端、疏水比例及残基组成；AHTPDB提供实验参考肽来源。
zh.modelsText: pLM4ACE-LR与pLM4ACE-SVM使用ESM-2序列表征；AHTpin-IC50为本地方法复现。共识权重为LR 50%、SVM 30%、AHTpin复现20%。

en.title: Peptide Bioactivity Post-processing Platform
en.subtitle: Sequence priorities × MS evidence × Chromatography & abundance × Mechanism networks × Peptide docking
en.preview: Completed result snapshot · Python platform interface
en.filter: Enter a sequence or protein identifier
en.dataNote: Stored results: 55 peptides across 11 samples; original scores and identification q-values retained.
en.rankingPlot: Joint prioritization by bioactivity features and relative abundance
en.algorithmPlot: Multi-algorithm predictions for the top 20 candidates
en.networkIntro: A presentation of peptide, target, pathway and phenotype relationships.
en.prepNote: Prepare receptor and peptide conformations, define the reference-ligand pocket and standardize parameters.
en.selectAll: Submit all peptides in the candidate pool
en.confirm: Confirm individual submission of selected peptides
en.exportLead: Organize candidates, observations, descriptors, networks, docking queues and parameters into a complete research report.
en.rulesText: ACE priorities combine length, C-terminal residues, hydrophobic balance and composition; AHTPDB supplies experimental reference-peptide evidence.
en.modelsText: pLM4ACE-LR and pLM4ACE-SVM use ESM-2 sequence representations. AHTpin-IC50 is a local method reproduction. Consensus weights are LR 50%, SVM 30% and AHTpin reproduction 20%.
en.compositeText: Default weights: activity 40%, peak area 25%, identification confidence 20%, chromatography 10% and recurrence 5%. Peak area and RT use within-sample percentiles.
en.workflowText: Sequence prioritization → MS evidence review → Targeted identification → Docking and mechanism analysis → Synthetic-peptide activity assays.
en.presentationText: The interface follows the Python application; existing result tables and figures are preloaded. Business controls are disabled. Rule scores, identification q values and docking scores describe distinct evidence.
